The new receipt email is now behind a flag in `services/notifier`, and the notifier tests pass (2 tests). There was no new receipt email in the repo, so I made up a minimal one that you'll want to replace.

- **Flag:** `NOTIFIER_FF_NEW_RECEIPT_EMAIL`, following the notifier's env-var convention. The notifier can't read the root `flags.toml`, so it doesn't use `flags.is_on()`. The new email is sent only when the variable is `"1"`. Unset or any other value keeps the current `receipt` template.
- **Code:** `send_receipt` in `notifier/email.py` picks `receipt_v2` or `receipt` based on the flag.
- **Templates:** I added `templates/receipt_v2.mjml` and `receipt_v2.txt`, with the plain-text copy the template convention requires. The wording is placeholder text, so swap in the real design and copy.
- **Tests:** I added a test that the flag selects `receipt_v2`. The existing test still covers the flag-off case.

On "gradually": this is an on/off switch per deployment, not a percentage rollout. If you want a percentage (for example, hashing the invoice id into buckets), say so and I'll add it.
